answer: Divergent Challenge Relay: each identity must solve a fresh challenge derived from its own past outputs and publish before seeing peers’ answers. A clone farm shares one history, so its members reply identically on a shared terrace and get flagged as duplicates. Every honest voyage through the relay adds unique entropy, while attackers must run independent solvers per identity. The per-identity summit cost is a full separate challenge stream plus wasted compute on colliding replies.
